title: Analytic: Gaussian beam waist growth and Gouy phase, E_z (FDFD)
description:
An E_z gaussian_beam (waist w0 = 1.5 um on its line, lambda 1 um, vacuum, stationary FDFD solve) launched from a vertical line at x_src toward +x (the -x half is absorbed by the x_lo CPML). The beam axis lies on the y_lo symmetric mirror plane (E_z even; the plane is the window edge y = 0, the inner face of the padded ghost cell, so the beam centre is 0 and the probes and lines run along the first window row, dx / 2 off the axis; a centre off the plane folds the profile into exp(-((|y| - c) / w0)^2), whose far field is 1 + erf(c / w0) stronger: +3 % at c = dx), which halves the unknowns (~9e4 incl. PML, host SuperLU).
Analytic (2D beam: half the 3D Gouy phase), u = (x - x_src) / zR: |E| = A (1 + u^2)^(-1/4) exp(-y^2 / w^2), w = w0 sqrt(1 + u^2), on-axis phase -k_num (x - x_src) + atan(u) / 2. With first-order non-paraxial terms (angular spectrum, eps = 1 / (k0 w0)^2 = 0.011; the k / k_x factor of a sheet source and the k_y^4 term of k_x) the axis field is multiplied by C(u): Re C = 1 + eps / (1 + u^2) - 1.5 eps u^2 / (1 + u^2)^2, arg C = eps u / (1 + u^2) + 0.75 eps u (1 - u^2) / (1 + u^2)^2 (so the field on the line is A (1 + eps), as the waist help text says). Discrete: k_num = (2 / dx) asin(k0 dx / 2) and zR = k0 cos(k_num dx / 2) w0^2 / 2 (the paraxial curvature of the 5-point stencil), 7.01 um.
Derived values tab: E_line (|E_z| on the source line, 1.011 A: the paraxial A would miss by 1.1 %, tolerance 0.5 %), E_zR / E_2zR (|E_z| at one and two Rayleigh lengths, 0.842 / 0.668 A, tolerance 1 %), gouy_zR / gouy_2zR (probe phase plus k_num (x - x_src), wrapped: the Gouy phase pi / 8 / atan(2) / 2 plus arg C, 0.398 / 0.556 rad, tolerance 5 %; a plane wave gives 0).
Line profile tab: E_axis (|E_z| along the axis from 0.5 um to 2 zR), Re_axis (Re E_z there: the Gouy phase shifts the carrier by up to 0.56 rad, so without it the curve misses by ~half its range) and E_transverse (|E_z| across the beam at x_src + zR, paraxial Gaussian of width w0 sqrt(2)); tolerances 2 % / 3 % / 3 % of the curve range, to be confirmed by the first run. Field tab: |E_z| and Re E_z.

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the solve

parameters.name: k_vac
parameters.description: vacuum wavenumber k0 in 1/m (k0 is the Bessel K_0 function)

parameters.name: w0
parameters.description: beam waist radius (1/e of the field) on the source line

parameters.name: A_beam
parameters.description: beam amplitude parameter in V/m (paraxial peak E_z on the line)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (25 cells per wavelength)

parameters.name: k_num
parameters.description: discrete axial wavenumber of the 5-point stencil in 1/m

parameters.name: k_par
parameters.description: wavenumber of the discrete paraxial curvature dk_x / d(k_y^2) = -1 / (2 k_par)

parameters.name: zR
parameters.description: Rayleigh length in m (7.01 um)

parameters.name: eps_np
parameters.description: non-paraxial parameter 1 / (k0 w0)^2 (0.011)

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: domain length along x (390 cells; CPML outside)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: domain height above the mirror plane region (210 cells; CPML above)

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: source line x (a cell centre, 0.5 um)

parameters.name: y_row
parameters.description: centre of the first window row, dx / 2 above the mirror plane y = 0

parameters.name: x_1
parameters.description: probe 1 distance from the source line: whole cells nearest zR

parameters.name: x_2
parameters.description: probe 2 distance: whole cells nearest 2 zR

parameters.name: u_1
parameters.description: probe 1 distance in Rayleigh lengths

parameters.name: u_2
parameters.description: probe 2 distance in Rayleigh lengths

parameters.name: E_line_ref
parameters.description: |E_z| on the source line cell in V/m

parameters.name: E_1_ref
parameters.description: |E_z| at probe 1 in V/m

parameters.name: E_2_ref
parameters.description: |E_z| at probe 2 in V/m

parameters.name: gouy_1_ref
parameters.description: Gouy phase plus arg C at probe 1 in rad

parameters.name: gouy_2_ref
parameters.description: Gouy phase plus arg C at probe 2 in rad
